title: Nasruddin and the Boat
summary: When a squall hit a lake boat, the passengers wailed and tore their hair in terror....
full_text:
When a squall hit a lake boat, the passengers wailed and tore their hair in terror.

Nasruddin lay comfortably in the bow, snoring peacefully.

"Mulla, are you not afraid of sinking?" cried a passenger.

"Why should I worry?" yawned Nasruddin. "The boat does not belong to me; it belongs to the ferryman!"
moral: Panicking in the storm achieves nothing; calm endurance rides the waves.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "Nasruddin and the Boat"?
options: Foolishness hides wisdom; laughter teaches truth
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
